metadata.title: SSPP Instance - Trusted Cloud (Microsoft Entra ID)

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative Trusted Cloud platform trust expectations.

system-characteristics.system-description: Microsoft-operated identity and access management SaaS providing authentication, federation, and authorization control-plane services for institutional systems.

props.name: cloud-service-model
props.remarks: Entra ID is consumed as a multi-tenant SaaS identity control plane.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Owns institutional reliance on Entra ID for identity services.

props.name: business-owner
props.remarks: Accepts residual platform trust and jurisdictional risk for identity services.

props.name: tenant-model
props.remarks: Identity data is logically isolated per tenant within a Microsoft-operated multi-tenant platform.

props.name: isolation-boundary
props.remarks: The Entra ID tenant is the isolation boundary for identity objects, policies, and authentication context.

props.name: personal-data-scope
props.remarks: Entra ID stores identity-related personal information including usernames, display names, alternate email addresses, phone numbers (MFA and recovery), device identifiers, and authentication metadata.

props.name: data-residency
props.remarks: Identity-related personal data is geo-located within North America, with customer tenant instances hosted in the United States.

props.name: data-sovereignty
props.remarks: Microsoft Entra ID is operated by a U.S.-owned provider and is subject to U.S. jurisdiction, which may permit lawful access under U.S. law regardless of data storage location.

props.name: provider-admin-access
props.remarks: Privileged administrative access to tenant infrastructure is performed by Microsoft personnel under internal controls and auditing.

props.name: independent-assurance
props.remarks: Microsoft maintains independent third-party security attestations (including SOC 2 and ISO certifications) applicable to Entra ID services.

props.name: logging-availability
props.remarks: Authentication, audit, and directory activity logs are generated by the platform and made available to tenants subject to service licensing.

props.name: subprocessor-transparency
props.remarks: Microsoft discloses subprocessors and provides change notification consistent with contractual terms.

props.name: data-exit-support
props.remarks: Tenant directory and identity data may be exported using supported Microsoft APIs upon service termination.

components.title: Microsoft Entra ID Control Plane
components.description: Multi-tenant identity control-plane platform operated by Microsoft.
components.remarks: This SSPP instance evaluates Entra ID strictly at the platform trust level. Authentication policies, MFA behavior, federation architecture, and identity lifecycle controls are evaluated in secure-identity and entra-id-sso SSPPs.

control-implementation.remarks: Trusted Cloud controls for Entra ID are satisfied through provider disclosures, independent assurance, tenant isolation mechanisms, and evidence availability. Jurisdictional and residency considerations are explicitly declared to support policy-driven assessment.
